name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.8 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 19 times in 7 visits over 72 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 36 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.0 days starting 2025-12-22, at wavelengths from 1.34 to 4.85 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
